Session.title: Session
Session.description: A recorded clinical tremor and grip pressure assessment session with differential phenotype analysis.

userId.description: The ID of the user who recorded the session.

timestamp.description: The start time of the session (Unix timestamp).

duration.description: The duration of the session in seconds.

severity.description: The calculated severity level (Normal, Mild, Moderate, Severe).

rms.description: The Root Mean Square value of the tremor.

frequency.description: The dominant frequency of the tremor in Hz.

phenotype.description: Differential classification (e.g., Parkinsonian Tremor (PD), Essential / Postural Tremor (ET)).

pdProbability.description: Probability score (0-100) for Parkinsonian resting tremor.

etProbability.description: Probability score (0-100) for Essential / postural tremor.

avgForce.description: Mean isometric grip force from FSR sensor.

integrityHash.description: Server-generated HMAC-SHA256 integrity digest for clinical auditability.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores recorded tremor assessment sessions for authenticated clinicians and patients.
